script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

TITLE: THE RISE OF RAVENWOOD

INT. RAVENWOOD GYM - DAY

Coach MCCORMICK, a grizzled, yet passionate man in his mid-50s, paces nervously before a wall of mirrors reflecting the gym's worn floors and outdated equipment. A SIGN reads "Ravenwood High School."

Suddenly, the door SWINGS open and in walks JIMMY, a lanky, earnest young man in his late teens.

COACH MCCORMICK
(looking Jimmy up and down)
Jimmy, you're late.

JIMMY
(apologetic)
Sorry, Coach. Got held up.

INT. RAVENWOOD GYM - LATER

Jimmy, wearing a threadbare T-shirt and shorts, sweats profusely as he and Coach McCormick work on his form during a grueling workout.

COACH MCCORMICK
(encouragingly)
Almost got it, Jimmy. Keep pushing yourself.

INT. RAVENWOOD HIGH SCHOOL - CLASSROOM - DAY

Jimmy sits at a DESK, surrounded by CHATTING CLASSMATES. He seems out of place, distracted, and uncomfortable.

Ms. THOMPSON, a stern, but fair teacher, calls on Jimmy.

MS. THOMPSON
Jimmy, what's the significance of the metaphor "a rose in a field of thorns"?

Jimmy hesitates, looking around for inspiration. He then raises his hand tentatively.

JIMMY
(awkwardly)
Uh, it means standing out from the crowd? Being unique?

The room erupts in laughter. Jimmy's face falls. Ms. Thompson looks disapproving but doesn't intervene.

INT. RAVENWOOD GYM - NIGHT

Jimmy trains alone, drenched in sweat and frustration. Coach McCormick watches from a distance, impressed by Jimmy's determination.

COACH MCCORMICK
(approaching Jimmy)
You have what it takes, Jimmy. Believe in yourself.

INT. RAVENWOOD HIGH SCHOOL - CAFETERIA - DAY

Jimmy, sitting alone at a TABLE, is approached by MIKE, a popular, confident student.

MIKE
Hey, Jimmy. You're working pretty hard in that gym, huh?

JIMMY
(guarded)
Just trying to get in shape.

MIKE
You know what they say, Jimmy. If you ain't first, you're last.

JIMMY
(firmly)
I'll be first in my own way.

INT. RAVENWOOD GYM - LATE NIGHT

Jimmy, fueled by determination, lifts heavier weights than ever before. He grunts with effort, pushing himself to his limits.

INT. RAVENWOOD HIGH SCHOOL - COMMUNITY CENTER - DAY

Ravenwood hosts a community event featuring various athletic competitions. Jimmy, competing in the long jump, faces off against Mike and other townspeople.

With one powerful leap, Jimmy lands in the sand pit FARTHER than any other competitor, earning him a round of applause and admiration from his peers.

INT. RAVENWOOD GYM - DAY

Coach McCormick, now beaming with pride, watches as Jimmy and his newfound friends, including Mike, train together.

MS. THOMPSON enters, looking surprised.

MS. THOMPSON
I've never seen you in the gym before, Jimmy. What's the change?

JIMMY
(smiling)
I've been believing in myself. And I'm not alone anymore.

MS. THOMPSON
(smiling back)
That's a beautiful thing.

INT. RAVENWOOD HIGH SCHOOL - CAFETERIA - DAY

Jimmy, now a respected and integral part of Ravenwood, shares a table with Mike and his friends, laughing and enjoying their camaraderie.

MS. THOMPSON watches from a distance, a look of pride on her face.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
